measurement: cloud service under Render free-tier-like limits
environment: Docker Desktop (WSL2) on an x86-64 Windows 11 laptop; cloud image built from docker/cloud/Dockerfile; docker run --cpus 0.1 --memory 512m; PostgreSQL 16 in a container on the same Docker network (no internet latency, unlike Neon)
cold_start_definition: docker run to the first HTTP 200 from /health, measured with curl polling every 0.2-0.5 s
cold_start_before_note: Spring Boot 4 reported 'Started in' 115/107/106 s; wall time to /health slightly higher
catchup_first_run_note: same scenario with the previous device build (no adaptive batches; per-sample rows); online results were not timed in that run
not_measured: real Render shared vCPU, Render wake-up time after sleep, Neon network latency and scale-to-zero resume
